description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the ResultList interface, providing a read-only collection of items with pagination support, along with associated metadata like next page offset and sort values.

classes.name: ResultListImpl
classes.description: An immutable, generic implementation of the ResultList interface that holds a list of items with pagination and sort information.

methods.name: ResultListImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing with items and pagination info, creating an unmodifiable copy of the provided items list.

methods.name: ResultListImpl
methods.description: Overloaded constructor including sort values for the last result.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the item at specified index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of items.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if an object is in the list.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the items.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all items.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all items, using provided array if large enough.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an item to the list; note that this modifies the internal list which is unmodifiable, so in practice, this method would throw an UnsupportedOperationException unless the internal list is modifiable. But in the current code, this may be an oversight.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an object from the list.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if all elements of a collection are in the list.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds all elements from a collection to the list; same note as above regarding mutability.

methods.name: addAll (with index)
methods.description: Adds a collection at specific position; seems inconsistent with immutability around internal list.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all elements in a collection from the list.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only the elements in the collection.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the list.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Replaces the element at specified position.

methods.name: add (at index)
methods.description: Inserts an element at specific index.

methods.name: remove (at index)
methods.description: Removes element at specific index.

methods.name: indexOf
methods.description: Returns index of first occurrence.

methods.name: lastIndexOf
methods.description: Returns index of last occurrence.

methods.name: listIterator
methods.description: Returns a list iterator.

methods.name: listIterator
methods.description: Returns a list iterator starting at a specific position.

methods.name: subList
methods.description: Returns a view of part of the list.

methods.name: nextPageOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset for the next page.

methods.name: lastResultSortValues
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the sort values of the last result if available.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code for the object.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns string representation of the object.
